characters.summary: Killer Croc is a massive, reptilian human mutant who relies on brutal physical strength, sharp claws and teeth, and an amphibious physiology to overwhelm opponents in close combat.

mechanisms: Thick, scaled dermis acting as natural body armor
Extreme durability against blunt force trauma

weaknesses: Reptilian vulnerability to extreme cold temperatures
Low intelligence or berserker rage easily exploited by tactical opponents
limitations: Limited to close-quarters melee combat with no ranged attack options
Slower land mobility compared to top-tier agile fighters

sources.supports: General background, physical traits, aquatic abilities, and weaknesses.

feats.claim: Ripped a bank vault door off its hinges with bare hands.

notableResults.note: Batman regularly exploits Croc's low intellect and vulnerability to environmental hazards.

campaignTags.claim: Adapted to living and fighting underwater with ease.
Exceptional swimming capability in sewers and open water.
Can breathe underwater due to his reptilian mutation.
Possesses accelerated healing from physical wounds.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability and strength scaling during heightened mutations.

characters.summary: Killer Frost is a metahuman who absorbs and projects intense cold energy, capable of freezing enemies instantly or creating intricate ice constructs and projectiles.
weaknesses: Requires constant absorption of heat or thermal energy to survive and maintain powers
limitations: Powers are fatal to her without an external heat source to siphon from.
Must be near warmth or nuclear energy to prevent physical deterioration.

sources.supports: Powers of cryokinesis, thermal absorption weakness, and general abilities.

feats.claim: Froze a large section of a city street instantly during a confrontation.

notableResults.note: Firestorm outmaneuvered her thermal absorption abilities.

campaignTags.claim: Generates and manipulates ice at will.
Can project intense cold and shape ice constructs.

unknowns: Variations between different women who have held the Killer Frost mantle.

characters.summary: King Shark is a massive shark-human hybrid possessing immense super-strength, razor-sharp teeth, and complete aquatic dominance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to intense electricity conducted through water
limitations: Limited effectiveness outside of water or humid environments for extended periods

sources.supports: Origins as a shark god's son, physical attributes, and aquatic powers.

feats.claim: Swam through high-pressure deep ocean trenches unharmed.

notableResults.note: Aquaman defeated him using marine control and superior combat skill.

campaignTags.claim: Native marine predator adapted to deep-sea combat.
Moves at high speeds through aquatic environments.
Breathes underwater naturally.
Stands well over eight feet tall with massive bulk.
Regenerates lost tissue and damage rapidly.

unknowns: Exact parentage retcons across different eras regarding the Shark God.

characters.summary: Krypto is a Kryptonian dog who possesses virtually all the same solar-powered abilities as Superman, fighting with canine instincts, super-speed, and heat vision.
limitations: Dependent on yellow sun radiation to maintain superhuman abilities
Canine intellect limits complex strategic planning

sources.supports: Kryptonian powerset, canine physiology, and vulnerabilities.

feats.claim: Traveled across interstellar space under his own power.

notableResults.note: Assisted Superman by attacking Mongul's face.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly under yellow sun radiation.

unknowns: Full extent of his intelligence scaling compared to standard Earth dogs.

characters.summary: Larfleeze, the sole wielder of the Orange Light of Avarice, creates an endless horde of hard-light energy constructs that mimic anyone he has ever killed.

mechanisms: Swarm of autonomous hard-light constructs intercepting attacks

weaknesses: Vulnerability if separated from his central orange power battery
limitations: Must remain relatively close to his central orange power battery to maintain maximum power output
Extreme mental fixation on possessing objects

sources.supports: Orange light mastery, construct creation, and obsession with the power battery.

feats.claim: Fought multiple Green Lantern Corps members simultaneously alone.

notableResults.note: Defelled numerous lantern squads using his construct army.

conditional.ability: Orange light construct generation and flight

campaignTags.claim: Flies using the power of his orange lantern ring.
Teleports across stellar distances via ring manipulation.

unknowns: Exact lifespan and origins before acquiring the orange light.

characters.summary: Lex Luthor is a supreme intellect who relies on advanced powered armor, high-tech weaponry, and meticulous preparation to combat superpowered foes.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on his technology working without interference
limitations: Physically ordinary human without his technological suits
Requires prep time to counter unpredictable magic or cosmic threats

sources.supports: Genius intellect, use of warsuits, and hatred of Superman.

feats.claim: Built a warsuit capable of trading blows with Superman.

notableResults.note: Superman frequently overcomes his suits through superior speed and power.

campaignTags.claim: Wears a sophisticated warsuit granting superhuman stats.
Warsuit incorporates jet propulsion for flight.
Creates revolutionary technology and weaponry.
Utilizes numerous hidden weapons and anti-hero devices.

unknowns: Extent of his financial resources during various corporate restructuring phases.

characters.continuity: DC Comics Year of the Villain
characters.summary: Apex Lex is an upgraded hybrid form endowed by Perpetua with Martian abilities, apex predator physiology, and reality-warping energy manipulation.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to intense heat/fire due to Martian DNA
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard human body and warsuit with a Martian-human hybrid apex predator body granting natural flight, telepathy, and energy projection.

sources.supports: Year of the Villain transformation and Perpetua upgrade details.

unknowns: Full duration of the Perpetua upgrade before his eventual return to normal.

characters.summary: Lex Luthor wearing advanced Apokolips armor and bearing a Superman crest, combining his intellect with New Gods technology and Omega-level weaponry.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to specialized New Gods weaponry
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard warsuit with high-tier Apokolips armor integrated with Mother Box technology, vastly increasing his energy projection and physical protection.

sources.supports: Justice League membership and use of Apokoliptian armor.

unknowns: Long-term health effects of wearing Apokoliptian tech.

characters.summary: Lobo is an indestructible Czarnian bounty hunter who uses extreme violence, massive chain weapons, a space motorcycle, and an absolute immunity to death to slaughter his targets.

mechanisms: Absolute regeneration from a single drop of blood
Immunity to aging, disease, and vacuum of space

weaknesses: Bounty contracts and promises can sometimes bind his chaotic nature
limitations: Prone to getting distracted by alcohol, brawls, and bounties
Cannot be permanently killed by conventional means

sources.supports: Czarnian physiology, regeneration feats, space bike, and combat style.

feats.claim: Killed the entire population of his home planet Czarnia.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill due to Lobo's regeneration matching Superman's strength.

campaignTags.claim: Survives and flies through deep space unassisted.
Regenerates instantly from complete vaporization.
Regrows his entire body from a single cell or drop of blood.
Rides his interstellar Space Hog motorcycle in combat.
Expert pilot of starships and interstellar vehicles.

unknowns: Continuity reboots regarding his exact bounty tracking history.

characters.summary: Lucifer Morningstar is an omnipotent cosmic being wielding creation-level divine will, able to shape reality, manipulate matter, and destroy universes with a thought.
weaknesses: Bound by cosmic rules and personal codes of absolute honesty and honor
limitations: Cannot create something out of literally nothing without divine backing (outside of the Demiurgic power)
Prefers manipulation and free will over direct brute force

sources.supports: Cosmic status, reality manipulation, and divine abilities.

feats.claim: Created an entire alternate universe complete with stars and life.

notableResults.note: Exchanged words and power demonstrations without actual combat escalation.

campaignTags.claim: Flies across creation using divine will.
Opens doorways to any dimension or universe effortlessly.
Wields supreme divine magic and creation powers.
Instantly teleports anywhere in existence.
Can transport others across realms instantly.

unknowns: Full extent of his powers outside of the DC/Vertigo cosmological structure.
